title: Very shabby chic/retro as I wanted!
text: Very shabby chic/retro as I wanted!. The only problem is the crochet corners are too tight and don’t lay flat. I may have to stretch them and iron so it’s totally flat.

product_metadata.title: Laura Ashley Crochet Cotton 17x24 in. Bath Rug, Creamy White
features: Elegant Laura Ashley style features plush cut-and-loop fibers woven with a chic crochet border
Each 100% natural Cotton bath rug is reversible and highly absorbent
Rug grippers or rug pad recommended (sold separately)
description: Classically chic, Laura Ashley Crochet Bath Rug Collection features 100% natural cotton rugs in an assortment of rich, saturated colors. Durable cut-and-loop fibers, woven with a lovely crochet border, are reversible for long-lasting use. Available in white, ivory, aqua blue, linen, light grey, indigo, and blush pink. Size options are perfect for any bathroom, bedroom or living area. Machine washable cotton makes cleaning a breeze. Includes (1) 17" x 24" bath rug. Machine wash cold separately with mild detergent. Do not bleach. For best results, hang dry. Imported.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash cold separately with mild detergent. Do not bleach. For best results, hang dry.
